title: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
visualBrief: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao: complete mapped asymmetric museum with long eastern fish-like gallery and pointed roof fins, clustered flared/leaning titanium lobes, 41m central lantern, tall river-facing glazed atrium and raised canopy, warm limestone south/west gallery ranges and curved entrance steps. Specific mapped parts guide plan/height; curved shell profiles, mullion inventory and hidden roofs are picture-led approximations. Independent La Salve bridge, surrounding buildings, promenade, pools and contemporary artworks are excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q179199 and named museum OSM way118499485 v50/native35184490588317. Standard Protomaps20261020 detailed parent and20 integrated building parts; independently mapped overhead atrium canopy way118506112 v6/building=roof/min_level6 belongs to the museum, with original ground retained beneath it. All other native records retained. East arm is +X; main entrance is south/+Z and river front is north/-Z. Heading0 with full geographic east/south controls.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped body11m and distinct part heights17/20/23/26/29/32/35/41m retained as silhouette controls above working museum floor9.7m absolute. Canopy is raised16..23m above that floor. Titanium flare/lean/top slopes and glass roof profiles are approximate reconstructions from three ordinary pictures, not exact CAD/survey. Entrance has a reconstructed curved descending flight to the lower museum level; accessibility and hidden interiors unverified.
